nodes.title: SG-8.4.2 quality gate: context.md Stack and module table match the real repo
nodes.body:
Context: repo-root context.md is still the 71-line README-only scan. It has 13 UNKNOWN placeholders, 'hello Worldseed', 'echo no build' and 'echo no test'. Desired behavior: the Stack names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest and Go. The Modules table lists game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/. Expected result: the contextDoc and contextPaths unit tests pass against the real context.md. Why: this is the last open check of SG-8.4.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when STACK_TERMS and Go are checked, then none are missing and no UNKNOWN token appears
- Given the repo-root context.md, when staleTextHits runs, then it returns []
- Given the context.md Modules table, when contextModulePaths runs, then it includes the four required paths and every path exists on disk


## Scope
- In scope: Docs-check helpers docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts that define the Stack and module-table contract
- In scope: Unit tests that read the real context.md
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code
- Out of scope: Gameplay, UI or art changes
- Out of scope: Writing context.md or .ai-dlc files from Act or Verify units
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- Preserve: Existing tests, none deleted or skipped
- Preserve: Gameplay unchanged


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No source file over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- backend/ and the contribution/round API are out of scope
- Every step lands green: npm test and npm run typecheck in game/ and game/frontend/


## Definition of done
- Both requirements are met and their Verify units pass
- Evidence ticket is attached


## Clarifying questions
- None
